sources.content: CVE Details | ID: CVE-2026-1001 | Severity: CRITICAL | Component: RTSP Service | Description: Critical flaw in Hikvision camera RTSP implementation allows unauthenticated users to access live video streams by bypasssing the authentication check. Affects versions prior to 5.6.8. | Remediation: Update firmware to version 5.6.8 or later. Disable RTSP if not required, or restrict access via firewall.

CVE Details | ID: CVE-2026-1008 | Severity: LOW | Component: ONVIF Service | Description: Amcrest cameras are susceptible to a Denial of Service (DoS) attack. A sequence of malformed ONVIF Discovery packets can crash the networking stack, requiring a physical power cycle. | Remediation: Disable ONVIF if not used. Amcrest is working on a firmware fix. Restrict local network access to trusted devices only.
